name: n8n
cost: Not stated in the README. You can self-host it under its Sustainable Use License, and there is also a cloud version.
works_with: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or open-source models, plus 1500+ integrations
short: A visual workflow builder for AI agents and automations that you can self-host, with 1500+ integrations and code when you need it.
what: n8n is a platform for building AI agents and automated workflows on a visual canvas. You can drop into JavaScript, Python or npm packages for the hard parts. It connects to 1500+ integrations and has 9,000+ workflow templates, and you can run it yourself or in n8n's cloud.
who: People who want to wire AI models into their existing apps and data without writing a whole backend. If you only need a single script, plain code is simpler.
needs: Docker, for both the install script and the manual install

steps.title: Install with the script
steps.text: The quickest route in the README. Read the script before you run it.

steps.title: Or create a data volume for a manual install
steps.text: Your workflows are stored in this volume.

steps.title: Open the editor
steps.text: Go to http://localhost:5678 in your browser.

try.label: A first prompt
try.text: Open one of the workflow templates from n8n.io/workflows and run it once to see how the nodes connect.

watch: The quick-start command pipes a script from the internet straight into your shell. Read https://get.n8n.io first.
